notes: Editing upgrades. The format bubble gets a ⋯ menu: highlight, inline math, clear formatting, and Turn into a heading, quote or list. Tables get row and column grips to insert, move, align or delete, and Tab moves between cells. Drag a heading in the outline to move its whole section, or press ⌘⇧↑/↓ to move a block. A new Insert menu holds everything the / menu does, and / now works in an empty document and in table cells. Built on tinyjs 0.50.1.
